critique.evidence: Across desktop, tablet, and mobile, the screen has a cohesive, polished forensic-console aesthetic: strong headline hierarchy, restrained cyan/green/yellow status colors, consistent monospaced metadata, crisp dividers, and a clearly structured query-to-precedent narrative. Desktop uses the wide canvas effectively, tablet reflows the split panel cleanly, and mobile preserves the hierarchy without clipping or overlap. The main weakness is mobile density: several labels and explanatory lines are very small and low-contrast, while stacked precedent rows create a long, slightly repetitive scroll.
critique.fix: Increase mobile metadata and supporting-copy size/contrast, tighten vertical spacing within each precedent row, and consider a more compact mobile alignment that keeps similarity beside the precedent title rather than below it.
